source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.teacher_note: number line is settled by running 'Carry out Kaprekar's 4-digit routine and recognize when it reaches': For a 4-digit number with at least two different digits, form the largest and smallest — on the item about Place or read a number on a number line from the marked.

intelligence.enrichment: Equal lengths on a number line stand for equal numerical changes; when a 1000-unit interval is divided into five equal parts, each small step represents 200 units.
